posts.quote:
The peaks put on
their winter white.
We slowed down
to match them.

Ridge after ridge
fading into the mist.
No need to name them.
Just look.

Wind and water
took their time here.
A slow walk
is the right way to see it.

The cloud sat
on the summit all day.
We had lunch below it
and called it enough.

Cold hands
around a warm cup,
and a lake too still
to disturb with words.

Pale peaks, green water,
one long breath out
before the climb.

Tired legs,
a pink sky,
and the slow,
happy walk back.
